description: Reproducible shopping queries for manual evaluation of the shop skill against the live OpenCommerceIndex. Run each in a client, record the result in a copy of run-log.template.md. 'expected' describes what a correct answer contains; 'must_not' lists failures that invalidate the run.

expected.notes: Codes may carry a /xx suffix (EP5541/50, EP5543/90, EP5544/50, EP5547/90). Any EP554x variant counts as exact; other Philips series (EP2xxx, EP3xxx, EP4xxx) are approximate at best. Stores listing coffee/small-appliances and Philips in brands rank first. Country is not stated: the assistant may ask once or infer Uruguay only if context makes it clear.

must_not: a failed store reported as 'does not sell it'
a non-5500 series presented as exact
URL not retrieved during the run

expected.notes: Country is explicit; no clarification question should be asked. Answer in Spanish with $U prices as shown, source URL and retrieval time per offer, and a Cobertura block citing source_revision and generated_at.

Family-level query: many IdeaPad models exist (Slim 3, Slim 5, 1, Gaming). Results should list what each store shows with the exact title and the model identifier if present, marked approximate unless the user narrows it. Computing stores are the candidates; a technology store pricing in U$S must show U$S, not $U.

must_not: inventing a specific model the store did not show

expected.notes: Category climate (parent appliances). Candidates: stores with appliances or general. Expect a list of models with capacity as shown (12000 BTU / 3500 frigorías / 1 TR); approximate matches at other capacities must be marked as such.

must_not: reporting a 9000 or 18000 BTU unit as exact
a failed store reported as 'does not sell it'

expected.notes: Artisan stand mixers come in several capacities (4.8 L, 4.7 L, 5.6 L) and colours. Any 5KSM1xx is a match; colour variants are approximate unless the user named one. Stores listing KitchenAid in brands rank first.

must_not: a Classic or Professional series shown as exact

expected.notes: Magnifica S family is ECAM2x; Magnifica Evo (ECAM29x) and Magnifica Start (ECAM22.2x) are approximate. The apostrophe must be URL-encoded (%27) or dropped in the search query; try 'Magnifica S' and 'ECAM22' as the two attempts.

must_not: more than two attempts per store

expected.notes: tv-audio category. WH-1000XM4 and XM6 are approximate. Technology stores quoting U$S must be reported in U$S.

Variants: Standard (disc) vs Digital Edition, and bundles. Answer must say which variant each store shows; a result without variant information is approximate. Gaming/general stores are the candidates.

must_not: Digital and disc versions conflated as the same price

expected.notes: large-appliances. Capacity shown by stores varies (380 L to 420 L should be reported with the stated litres and marked approximate when not exactly 400 L). Stores that are technology-only are not candidates.

must_not: a failed store reported as 'does not sell it'

expected.notes: Budget filter in UYU. Only offers shown in $U at or below 20.000 qualify; offers in U$S must not be converted silently to judge the budget (either ask, or show them separately with the U$S price and say the budget was not applied). Say when a store had only pricier machines.

must_not: an offer above 20.000 presented as within budget

expected.notes: computing. Refresh rate must be read from the title or the product page; 165 Hz or 170 Hz monitors are approximate (exceed the spec), 75 Hz ones do not match. Report panel size as shown.

must_not: refresh rate invented when not shown

expected.notes: Category bedding exists in the taxonomy. At the time of writing no indexed store declares bedding; a general-marketplace store may be a candidate. Expected answer: either results from a 'general' store with titles as shown, or an honest 'no listed store declares this category' with the add-store link. Must not search unlisted stores.

must_not: searching stores not in the index
claiming no store in Uruguay sells mattresses

expected.notes: phones. Storage variant 128 GB is required for exact; 256 GB or iPhone 16e / 16 Plus / 16 Pro are approximate. Colours only when shown. U$S prices common.

small-appliances. Many models; list titles as shown with model numbers when present (BLSTxxx, Oster Pro, Classic). Stores listing Oster in brands rank first; absence of Oster in brands does not exclude a store.

must_not: excluding a store because Oster is not in its brands

expected.notes: small-appliances. Capacity as shown (4.5 L to 5.5 L approximate, 5 L exact). Mixed brands expected.

must_not: a failed store reported as 'does not sell it'

expected.notes: Every searched store should end in no_results (or a failure state when applicable). The answer must say nothing matched and must not propose unrelated products as if they matched. It may ask what the user meant. Coverage block still required.

must_not: claiming the product does not exist anywhere

queries.query: ¿cuánto sale la Nespresso Vertuo en Tienda Inglesa?

expected.notes: The named store is not in the index at the time of writing. Expected: state that the store is not listed and offer the add-store form; optionally show offers for the same product from listed stores, clearly labelled as other stores. Must not fetch the unlisted store's site as if it were indexed, and must not guess its price.

must_not: price attributed to the unlisted store without retrieval

queries.query: espresso machine with milk frother under 500 dollars

expected.notes: English query, budget in USD, stores mostly price in UYU. Expected: answer in English; do not silently convert. Either ask for the destination/currency handling or show $U prices and state that the USD budget was not applied (or apply an explicitly labelled indicative rate with date). Country should be asked once if not inferable.

must_not: silent conversion to judge the budget

queries.query: quiero comprar una cafetera Philips y que me la envíen a Argentina

expected.notes: Destination AR is not in the index's countries and no UY store confirms shipping to AR. Expected: say the index does not cover Argentina, that listed stores declare shipping to Uruguay only (or 'unknown/not confirmed' for AR), and offer the site and add-store links. Must not promise international shipping.

must_not: claiming a store ships to Argentina without a ships_to entry
searching stores not in the index

queries.query: notebook hasta 800 dólares o pesos, lo que sea más barato

expected.notes: Ambiguous currency: 800 USD vs 800 UYU is a 40x difference. Expected: treat as 800 USD (800 pesos cannot buy a notebook) but say so, or ask once. Show U$S offers at or under 800 as shown; $U offers listed with their price, with any conversion explicitly labelled with rate and date.

must_not: treating $ and U$S as the same currency
